segments.text: Madam Speaker, before we proceed with the sponsorship and plenary deliberations on House Bill No. 10858, I move to recognize the Hon. Perci Cendaña of Akbayan Partylist for a brief manifestation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker. Magandang hapon po sa ating mga kasamahan dito sa kapulongan ito at sa mga kababayan nating nanonood ngayon, lalong-lalo na ang mga miyembro ng Civil Society Organization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Speaker, my dear colleagues, this representation would like to raise an important concern from our Civil Society Organization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Last year po, nagkaroon tayo ng guidelines on CSO participation. Ito po ang chinampion ng ating good chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Chair Mika Suansing. Hindi naman po ito bago. May ganito na rin pong effort noong 15 Congress in 2006.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: It seems that while we are driving towards the right direction, this year, parang biglang nag-U-turn po tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Our CSOs are sharing their frustration about how they are being treated in the budget process for the 2027 General Appropriations Bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: nabanggit po ng mga CSO na sila daw ay na-seen zone, ni hindi nalaman that we adopted last year's guidelines until week 2 of our budget deliberations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Tapos ngayon, parang naghahabol tayo to bring them and draw them in.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kaya po ang tanong natin, Madam Speaker, my dear colleagues, aniyari?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Saan po tayo nagkaroon ng gap in terms of coordinating with our CSOs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Wala na bang mas makabulang participation than their questions being read out?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Will CSOs be informed and involved at sa magiging amendments sa budget through the BAR-C?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And most importantly, nagkaroon lang po ba ng guidelines on CSO participation last year dahil nabuking ang flood control projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa totoo lamang po, Madam Speaker, napakahalagan na ang transparency in winning back the confidence of our people in the budget process in this House.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: What we began last year was a very significant and important step and we have to learn from that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And from the unfortunate experiences of our CSO representatives this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: We hope that it's not too late for the House leadership to take this matter seriously and act on it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Hindi na pwedeng ipalusot lang sa kanila na we're still learning.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pera ng taong bayan, sa bulsa ng mamamayang Pilipino galing, ang pinag-uusapan nating P7.2 trillion na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa dulo po, hayaan po natin ang meaningful participation ng civil society organizations to define the kind of budget,

segments.text: So far po, yung roughly 52% na na-dispersed po for 2025, lahat po ng datos doon po sa releases, nandun na rin po, naka-upload na po sa Compass portal ng DBM.

segments.text: Ang nakalagay po doon yung amount of releases o yung goods that were given?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So pwede nating ma-filter po yun doon po sa Compass website.

segments.text: Sa apalagay niyo po, Madam Chair, equitable po ang distribution nito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: For 2026 po, Madam Speaker, equitable po dahil po lahat binigyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yung 2025 po, nakabatay po kasi sa kung sino yung nag-request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So posible po na may ibang mga LGU, may ibang mga probinsya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Na hindi po nag-request. So wala po silang natanggap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So sa 2027 po, paano po i-dedistribute ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Para po sa taong 2027, dahil po yung panukalang amount po ng LGU,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: GSF ay parehas doon sa 2026 ga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ang intensyon po ayon sa DBM ay pareho pa rin po yung distribution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So with regard to rice, lahat pa rin po na local government units mabibigyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And with regard to infrastructure po, it would still depend on whether there's an LGU that requested from a particular area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And it would still be consistent po with the same menu and criteria that we approve.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So in the 2027 ga, under the special provision for LGSF.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of our good mentor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Kaya po ako nagtatanong, sapagkat napakamahalaga po na masinop yung paggamit natin ng 7.2 trillion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Sapagkat sa 17.2 trillion, ang projected government revenue ay 5.2 trillion lamang. Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: At yun ay projected pa lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Sa bagsak nating GDP, baka hindi pa ma-realize.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Pagkatapos po, ang uutangin natin para ponduhan nito ay 1.69 trillion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Sa 1.69 trillion po, for development projects, kasama na yung mga ayuda, 1.1 trillion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, yung napuponduhan ng pagutang natin, pati yung personal services,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: pati yung MOOE. Kaya po mahalaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: At pagkatapos po, kailangan pa nating mangutang muli ng 3.3 trillion para bayaran yung mga nag-mature na utang natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Aside from the 1.69 trillion na uutangin para ponduhan ng 2027 national budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: 3.3 trillion para bayaran yung mga maturing na utang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, if we may clarify po, the 3.3 trillion peso borrowing already includes the deficit of 1.69.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, kabuuan na po na borrowing po natin yung 3.3 trillion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Tapos on top po yung iba pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin po, ang 1.69 trillion yung utangin for the 2027 national budget. Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: 1.694 trillion para po doon sa 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ang 1.6 trillion ay yun naman yung pangbayad po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Pangbayad po is doon sa mga nag-mature na natin na mga utang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, ibig pong sabihin, next year, after 2027, lalaki na naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Mas langong lalaki yung ating interest payment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Tama po, madam speaker. Last year po kasi, 0.996 trillion po yun po interest payments.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: At sa 2028, ang forecast po, although very preliminary, tataas din po kumpada sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ang ibig sabihin po ba dito ay lilit muli ang fiscal space for 2028?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of our good colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam speaker, if I may respond po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The last question. Sa kasalukuyan po, publicly available na rin po ang initial po na inaprobahan ng DBCC para po sa 2028 budget ay 7.2 trillion pesos pa rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, preliminarily po, preliminarily, yun po yung naaprobahan ng DBCC. So, tama po na dahil tataas yung interest payment sa 2028 pero po mananatiling 7.2 trillion pesos yung kabuuan ng budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In essence po, kinakain niya po yung ating fiscal space. So, ninipis po na konti yung fiscal space.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Thank you very much, Congressman Erice. Majority Leader?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much po, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much po to the Honorable Ege Erice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Robert Nazal of the BH Party List Interpolation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, through you, to the DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Your own 2026 NEP still contained the long-standing prohibition against impoundment of appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But in the enacted 2026 GAA, this was replaced by Section 78, suspension of expenditure, which allows the President to stop expenditure when public interest so requires.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The same provision is again proposed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, my question, Madam Chair, is Section 38 of the Administrative Code already gave the President authority to suspend expenditure when public interest so requires.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If that authority already exists, why was it necessary to remove the long-standing prohibition against impoundment provision and replace it with this provision?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much po, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, it is simply a reiteration of what is indicated in Section 38 of EO 292.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And actually po ginagawa rin naman po natin yun, hindi lang sa provision na to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May iba din po mga special provisions and general provisions na simple reiteration ng po sila noong pong substantive law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ngayon bigla na lang natin binago

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: to be given to the president

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, that is correct po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: 2026 GAA is the first wherein the terminology suspension of expenditure was used.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: However, in previous GAAs where impoundment was used, in terms of the concept and the spirit, it's the same po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We just changed the terminology in the 2026 GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But why did we change it?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Are we giving the President or the Executive additional authority by doing so?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, this is really just for consistency with EO 292

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: because the terminology that is used in EO 292 is suspension of expenditure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So just to be consistent po, given that we are reiterating that substantive law in the general provision of the GAA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: just to be consistent po, in the 2026 GAA, we also,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: carried the terminology suspension of expenditure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, wala po tayong, Madam Chair, we are not Distinguished Colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: wala po tayong dinadagdag na additional authority sa Presidente?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Wala po, Madam Speaker, we can categorically say we are not adding any more power.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We are just simply reiterating what is there in EO 292.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So we changed it because of a reiteration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, Distinguished Colleague, who proposed or requested this change?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Was it the DBM, the DOF or the Executive Department?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And sino po ang nag-introduce nito sa BICAM?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: My time is running. Can you please pause it?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Session resumed. The sponsor may respond quickly.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker. So for this particular general provision,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: This was concurred by both houses,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So who introduced this in the

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: to make a mistake po. So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: request for some time to look back at the

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and see po. We'll just trace back

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: po, just to make sure we answer

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that po, may we proceed with other questions

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and then we'll get back to you po

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ng ngayon by introducing this provision,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: naglalagay na naman tayo ng kulatilya

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: isuspend. Hindi po ba ganoon na nangyayari?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: actually po, even without this general provision,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ganon. So, the GAA is simply

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: a reiteration of that. So, we were

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: but rather we are simply just reiterating.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, why introduce it in the first place,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, why did we have to remove this provision?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, they're okay with removing this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: They will submit to the wisdom of Congress with regard to this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: they will submit to our wisdom

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: if we choose to take this out

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: since nandito pa rin siya sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: 2026, and we applied it to ano,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But when public interest so requires,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: May I ask, ano yung concrete example

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ano malya? Ano ba ang objective standard natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And has this provision been invoked already in 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, there is actually jurisprudence with regard to this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The Supreme Court has already ruled that the definition of when public interest requires is quite vague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In essence, leaving it up to the President to decide on that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: But we're pulling right now, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, this specific jurisprudence so we can cite it correctly.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Yung Arawlio po. Arawlio. You can look at Arawlio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the DBM is just pulling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The DBM is just pulling up the specific jurisprudence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, Distinguished Colleague, has this been invoked in 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, no. This particular general provision has not been invoked.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Diretso ko na lang po dun sa susunod kong tanong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, under the new Section 78,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: pwede ba ninyong gamitin ang public interest para hindi na i-release ang allotment for a project in the first place?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the answer is no po, given that these speak of two different things.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So this particular general provision only deals with suspension.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So hindi po pwedeng gamitin yung general provision na ito para hindi po i-release ang isa pong allocation or funding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Then Madam Chair, can DBM kadilis?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: DBM kategorikali confirm that public interest under Section 78 cannot be used to withhold the initial release of an allotment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The categorical answer of DBM is no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Hindi po pwedeng gamitin ito para mag-hold ng releases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: what provision now protects appropriations against impoundment

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: considering that the express prohibition against impoundment provision was removed?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: As a response, there is general provision number 3.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Which pertains to the General Appropriations Act as allotment order.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It says here that the General Appropriations Act upon its effectivity shall be considered the allotment authorizing agencies to obligate in accordance with its provisions except for two conditions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The first would be the appropriations that by virtue of law, general or special provisions, and rules and regulations, have conditions or requirements before release, and lump sum appropriations in the agency budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And special purpose funds that have no details necessary for release. So yun po yung safeguard, General Provision No. 3 po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So there are specific conditions by which a particular allotment would not be released; otherwise the general rule is it should be released.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Bakit po yung ano? Bakit po yung based doon sa NEP?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Bakit po yung congressional initiatives, nirequire ng aficero tapos nag-require ng additional requirements?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Wala po yun sa binasa nyo, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In the case po, I wouldn't call them congressional initiatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Those are probably, with your permission po, we'll tag them as items that have deviations between the NEP and the GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, yun po kasi, those are items that have not been vetted by the DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It didn't go through the usual process that the other projects had to undergo during the budget call.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, in that case po, it's an additional safeguard on the part of DBM

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: to be able to make sure that these projects,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: comply with the same requirements as the projects in the NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, meron pong ganong additional safeguard, kaya po naging FISARO po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ano po yung legal basis para gawin yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Every congressional initiative or amendment was done, dumaan po yan sa RDC and was properly vetted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I wanted to know what the legal basis was for the president to do a veto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: distinguished colleague, na pag dumaan po sa atin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: sa House, dumaan sa Senate, hindi po natin binibeta?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The legal basis po for this, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: is the veto power of the president as indicated in the veto message.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: There's a particular section there in the veto message that

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that pertains to increases in appropriations and new budgetary items.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: At doon po, linae out po yung mga conditions na kailangan po ma-meet for the release of these items

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that are either new budgetary items or saw increases in appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: In the 2026 GAA, ano yung veto message?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Saan po nakalagay na veto message yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Wala po sa veto message yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Doon po sa mismong veto message, it is under Section 6 with the header

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Increases in Appropriations and New Budgetary Items as Published po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: With the veto message as published in the official gazette.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Under what provision po nakalagay sa veto message?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: It pertains to increases in appropriations and new budgetary items.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I could read po the particular item if our distinguished colleague so desires.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In the exercise of the budget execution function vested upon the executive branch,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: it is understood that the increases in appropriations and new budgetary items introduced by the Congress in this budget

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: shall be subject to the national government's cash programming,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: applicable budget execution rules and procedures,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and approval by the president based on the program priorities of the government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Considering that such releases in appropriations and new budgetary items will have corresponding effects

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: on the outputs and outcomes of the agencies concerned,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: the DBM shall inform the said agencies of the changes in their respective appropriations

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and require the submission of their revised performance target.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So nasa first paragraph po, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleagues, yung mga conditions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Madam Chair, distinguished colleague.

segments.text: may I apply natin kung ang isang project ay nasa FISARO at wala pang SARO,

segments.text: can public interest be invoked so that the SARO is never released?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: My apologies, Madam Chair, Madam Speaker, medyo technical po kasi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May I request for the question to be reiterated, releases po ba or suspension?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kung ang isang project po ay nasa FISARO at wala pang SARO,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So looking at the Araulio jurisprudence, it defines the terminology that would allow for the use of savings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: If I may read out, just if you would allow me, Section 60, Section 54, and Section 53 of the General Provisions of the 2011, 2012, and 2013 GAAS, respectively, contemplate three sources of savings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So dinidefine po yung tatlong sources ng savings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: First, there can be savings when there are funds still available after completion of work, activity, or project,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: which means there are excess funds remaining after the work, activity, or project is completed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: There can also be savings when there is final discontinuance of the work, activity, or project,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: which means that there are funds remaining after work, activity, or project was started but finally discontinued before completion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: To illustrate, a bridge halfway completed is destroyed by floods or earthquake and thus finally discontinued

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: because the remaining funds are not sufficient.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Here, the funds are obligated but the remaining funds are deobligated upon final discontinuance of the project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: On the other hand, abandonment means the work, activity, or project can no longer be started because of lack of time to obligate the funds,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: resulting in the physical impossibility to obligate the funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: This happens when a month or two before the end of the fiscal year, there is no more time to conduct a public bidding to obligate the funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: The funds are not and can no longer be obligated and thus will constitute savings.

segments.text: labanan yung paggamit sa pamumulitika o sa patronahe ng ganitong tipo ng mga serbisyo at mga programa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, nakasaad din, Ginoong Speaker, sa Section 19 ang obligasyon ng Joint Congressional Oversight Committee on Public Expenditures.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para bantayan, subaybayan ang compliance ng mga national government agencies pagdating sa programa na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at yung compliance mismo ng NGAs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maaari ba nating malaman, nakapagpulong ba ang Joint Congressional Oversight Committee na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ano sa ngayon, yung inyong mga findings?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sa totoo po, ito pong Joint Congressional Oversight Committee on Public Expenditures

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: hindi pa po na-co-convene para po sa 20th Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ang dahilan po ay dahil nagkaroon po ng pagkakataon na nauna po kasing kino-convene yung InfraCom.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So medyo nagsabay-sabay po kasi yung mga oversight committees na pareho po yung intention na kanila pong babantayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So ang assurance po na maibibigay po natin sa ating distinguished colleague

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ay i-convene po natin soon yung Joint Congressional Oversight Committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, kailan ho balak ng Joint Congressional Oversight Committee na makapagpulong para dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sa kasalukuyan po kasi, nagsabay po yung budget deliberations ng Kamara at ng Senado.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Medyo inaayos lang po namin ng ating counterpart sa Senado, si Sen. J.V. Ejercito po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: yung chairman po ng Committee on Finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Pero kapag naayos po namin ito, ipabalitaan ko po kayo kaagad kung kailan po i-convene.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Medyo nabibusy lang po sa schedule ng budget hearings sa parehong kapulungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Naintindihan natin, Mr. Speaker, pero sa kabila nito, nakakadismaya pa rin po na nilalagay natin ang mga mahalagang seksyon na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: O ay nagiging strikto na tayo din ay nagiging seryoso sa pagpapatupad ng mga seksyon na makakatulong sa atin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: natiyakin na ang bawat piso napupunta talaga sa serbisyo para sa tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya ho, abangan natin yung mga guidelines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sana ho, kung meron ng initial na assessment, monitoring, ang DSWD, ang DOLE, gayon din ang DOH,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa pagtitiyak nito, ay pag-aaralan din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napakahalaga nito, ginoong speaker, dahil, halimbawa na lang po, gano'n ba kalaki yung pinag-uusapan natin na pondo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa, yung pondo sa AECS, na nasa 63.9 billion para sa 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan ho ay lagpa sa doble ng buong pondo ng Department of Science and Technology.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At yan din ho ay bilyong-bilyong pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sana ay nailalaan din natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa ibang mga proyekto, halimbawa, yung tulong para sa mga children with disability,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung tulong para sa mga nagiging biktima ng online sexual abuse and exploitation of children,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung tulong para sa mga adolescent parents and mothers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang lakiho na pangangailangan sa mga projects na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit nakita natin na hindi nabibigyan ng sapat na pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Kung maaari po akong tumugon, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ito pong mga nabanggit po ni Representative Elago,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: isa din po yan sa ating mga tinututukan ng mga programa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Kung matatandaan po natin sa Barisipo para sa GAA ng taong 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Nagdagdag po tayo sa Protect Teen under DSWD to protect,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Nagbigay din po tayo ng pondo sa ilalim ng OSIIC

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: para po sa protection ng youth at yung mga kabataan po against abuses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we are making sure po that these programs also get the funding that they need po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Hindi naman po dahil nagkakalon po ng pondo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: itong mga social services natin ay nakakaligtaan na po natin yung ibang mga programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: na mahahalaga din. So I'm with you po on that in making sure that we are able to fund these programs as well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Yung dun po sa monitoring, siguro po pagdating po ng iba't-ibang mga ahensya, maaari din po nating talakayin sa kanila yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Pag na-isa lang po natin yung DSWD, yung DOLE, yung DOH dito po sa plenaryo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So commitment ko po, maaari po na tutulungan ko po ang ating kasamahan na matanong din po yung mga ahensya patungkol po dun sa monitoring nila ng implementasyon ng Section 19.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, para ko sa kaalaman ng ating distinguished sponsor, na alam ko po ay talagang may pagtutok tulad ng kanyang nasabi sa mahalagang programa na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa 2027 na General Appropriations Bill, zero ang budget ng ESP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Enhanced Protecting, zero ang budget ng Project SAFE, zero ang budget para sa Project Aruga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan po yung para sa children with disability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nangangailangan at nananawagan sila na yung 25 million pesos na naibigay at nailagak para sa kanilang mga proyekto noong 2026 ay magpatuloy para sa 2027 at kung pwede pa nga ay mataas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil gayon din kalaki yung pangangailangan sa mga proyekto na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, aginoong speaker, hayaan nyo naman po ako magtanong tungkol sa pagpapaliwanag ng ating distinguished sponsor tungkol sa House Bill No. 10858 na naglalaman ng ating 2027 General Appropriations Bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung babasahin po natin ang ating mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: dahilan, ang paliwanag para sa ating mga budget priorities at direksyon para sa susunod na taon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: napaka-optimistic po ng ating mga nakikita para sa susunod na taon ng ating macroeconomic assumptions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa, para sa fiscal year 2027, ang ating projection para sa inflation rate ay nasa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pagdating naman sa foreign exchange rate, nasa 60 pesos to 60 pesos lamang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sa parehong halaga, aginoong speaker, ngayon hong September 2026, ay pareho na tayong lumagpas sa mga projection na ito para sa susunod na taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya hong katanungan ko ay ano yung mga hakbang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa, yung mga projection na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At paano natin magagawa rin na mapaunlad yung trabaho, yung kabuhayan, yung kalagayan ng ating mga kababayan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lalo lalo na sa panahon ngayon na bagsak na bagsak ang piso, pataas ang presyo ng mga biligin, pataas ang presyo ng pagkain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lumagpas na naman sa isang daang piso, tada litro, ang presyo ng gasolina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ayan po yung mga issue na lubos na nakapagpahirap sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, this is my colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So pagdating po doon sa mga macroeconomic assumptions na nabanggit po, halimbawa po inflation rate, foreign exchange rate, unemployment rate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: GDP growth, lahat po ng mga economic assumptions po, ina-update po siya ng DBCC every three months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So quarterly po yung pag-update noong mga macroeconomic assumptions and targets, base po sa mga nangyayadi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Halimbawa po kung may pagkakaiba po, halimbawa sa ini-impose na US tariffs, kailangan po i-update yun because that affects the global trade.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Or halimbawa po yung geopolitical conflict po sa Middle East, ina-update din po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So yun po yung dahilan kung bakit paminsan nagmumukha po na medyo optimistic siya masyado as compared to the current realities kasi i-update pa lang po siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In terms po of papaano po natin i-bridge yung gap sa pagitan po noong targets at saka yung actual po na nangyayadi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ang ginawa po sa pag-develop po noong budget, sinigurado po na maganda po yung kalidad noong mga spending priorities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po, nag-focus po doon sa mga programa na may mataas na economic multipliers o di kaya mag-generate po ng mas magandang mga trabaho

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: or mag-accelerate po ng government expenditures.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So ganun po yung ginagawa po ng DBCC family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ina-update po yung macroeconomic assumptions natin every three months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And at the same time po, sinisigurado po na yung mga pinapasok po ng mga activities and projects and programs sa budget ay talagang makakatulong po na mas mapabilis po yung paglago ng ating ekonomiya

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: at makakatugon po doon sa pinakailangan ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nabanggit Mr. Speaker ng ating Distinguished Sponsor yung tungkol sa pandaigdiga na crisis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit ang napakahalaga din na silipin natin paano naman yung krisis sa lokal na ekonomiya sa ating bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kumusta ba ang ating agrikultura? Kumusta ba ang ating manupaktura?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nakita po natin na ang agriculture at manufacturing, parehong bagsak na bagsak dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At makikita natin na halos walang nagbago mula 2026 sa kung paano natin tinitignan yung mga programa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa, pagdating sa micro-small-medium enterprise development program na nasa 900 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandiyan din yung industry development program na nasa 900 million noong 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At may konting pagtaas, may konting pagbaba para sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero wala hong signifikante na pagbabago sa kung paano natin na minamalaki.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung pagpapaunlad ng lokal na produksyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Gayun din ho, pagdating sa lokal na agrikultura, ang matagal na panawagan ng mga magsasaka at mga manginisda para sa production subsidy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Para matiyak na sa harap ng mga sunod-sunod na malalakas na bagyo, mga habagat na may dalang malakas na pagulan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa extreme heat, dulot din ang super-elminyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang mas mainit, kundi mga mas madalas at mas malalakas na mga bagyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakita ho natin na hindi po gumalaw yung mga priorities at hindi nakalapat sa pangangailangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung paano ba natin kitiyakin yung pagiging self-reliant ng ating national economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Na tayo ho ay matibay, nakakatindig sa sarili nating paa sa panahon na may matinding pandaigdigan na krisis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So pagdating po sa agrikultura, kung titignan po natin, nandiyan pa rin po yung Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May 30 billion pesos pa rin po doon para po makatulong sa makinarya, binhi, training at pautang para po sa ating mga magsasaka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We recognize the point of our distinguished colleague na kung titignan po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: NEP to NEP or GAAT to NEP yung pondo po ng agricultural sector bumaba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: From GAAT to NEP po bumaba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Kasi po nung BARC po na isinagawa natin dito sa Kamara noong nakaraang taon, malaki po kasi yung mga naidagdag natin para po sa agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Nakapaglagay po tayo para sa Presidential Assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Farmers and Fisher Folk, nakapaglagay po tayo para sa Farm to Market Road, mga deep water ports, mga irrigation, solar irrigation pumps and the like.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So sa atin pong parte, sa parte po ng Committee on Appropriations at sa atin po dito sa Kamara,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: iisa po yung ating paninindigan na gusto po talaga nating matulungan yung sektor ng agrikultura, gusto po nating matulungan ng ating mga magsasaka at manging isda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So on our part po, we will endeavor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In the next weeks that we are deliberating on the budget po at dinideliberate din po natin yung mga amyenda na gusto po nating maipasok na sana po magawa din natin yung nagawa natin noong nakaraang taon na madagdagan po natin yung mga pangangailangan na pondo ng ating agricultural sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Lalo na po merong banta ng El Nino na papadating.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So nabanggit din po yan ng DA, hingi po sana sa additional funding para sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Utilizer assistance, mga subsidies para po sa ating mga magsasaka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So ang aking assurance ay sa mga dadating na linggo po, sisiguraduhin po din natin na mabibigyan natin ng prioridad yung mga pangangailangan ng agriculture sector para po mapaigting yung lokal na production at saka masecure po yung ating food security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So seryoso tayo, ginaong speaker sa pagbibigay ng prioridad sa lokal na agrikultura at industrial.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So sa pagbibigay ng prioridad sa lokal na agrikultura at industrial, makakakita talaga tayo ng signifikante na pagbabago sa kung paano din nilalaanan ng kinakailangan pondo ang ating mga agencies na may kinalaman sa mga ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi natin kailangan ngayon ng bariya-bariya lang na pagtataas o bariya-bariyang pagbabago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kundi mas mataas, substantial, ayon sa pangangailangan para mapalakas ang ating agrikultura at industriyang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman may kinalaman din dito, ginaong speaker, section 34 ng ating...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: General Provisions ang tungkol sa Harmonized National Research and Development Agenda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari mo bang magulat ang ating distinguished sponsor sa kung nasusunod ba talaga yung pambansa na koordinado na nagagamit natin yung bunga ng mga pananaliksik ng ating mga government research institutions

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa iba't ibang mga services, needs, programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng iba't ibang national government agencies sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, kasama din dito, hindi lang po ang ating mga national government agencies,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kabilang din ang local government units, ang academe, ang industry, ang communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung paano ba titiyakin na yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: mga binawa, pinag-isipan, mga likha ng ating mga siyentista, ng ating mga manggagawa sa agham at teknolohiya ay lubos na napapakinabangan ng mamamayang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yan ho ay nakalagay sa ating general provisions na mahalaga para wala hong masasayang na resources pagdating sa research and development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, my apologies po. The question po is how do we monitor po, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, ito pong Section 34, yung Harmonized National Research and Development Agenda, the agency principally tasked to manage this government research and development agenda

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: One of the development agenda programs would be DOST. Sa kasalukuyin po, wala pong visibility yung DBM doon po sa actual na implementasyon nito. So kung papayagan po tayo na ating distinguished colleague, we can pose the same question to DOST when they're here for their plenary deliberations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, nagsumite ba ng progress report ang DOST tungkol dito sa ating House Committee on Appropriations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakalagay rin po kasi sa DOST.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa Section 34 na dapat sila ay dalga bibigay ng kopya ng kanilang progress report. Hindi lang po sa House Committee on Appropriations pero sa, ganyan din po sa Senado, sa iba't ibang mahalaga po na officials na may kinalaman sa pagpapatupad ng General Appropriations Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, given that the Committee on Appropriations is one of the recipients,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: supposedly, of the report, we are doing a quick check lang po. segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, natanong ko ito dahil ang DOST nakapag-develop ng isang local sexual assault investigation team.

segments.text: At nabalita nila sa atin dito sa Congress na namumblema sila, na meron silang napaunlad, meron silang produkto ng ating agham at teknoloy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na dito mismo sa ating bansa na paunlad.

segments.text: Ngunit ang problema, hindi naman ito ang unang prioridad pagdating sa procurement.

segments.text: Halimbawa, ng mga Women and Children Protection Unit sa ating mga ospital

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para makatulong sa timely collection ng forensic evidence na may kinalaman sa sexual assault cases

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at iba't iba pang kaso ng gender-based violence na makangailangan ng ganitong tipo ng kit.

segments.text: Namumblema po tayo na, kumbaga yung tawag po dyan ng mga Gen Z Millennials,

segments.text: Bagamat may ganitong napakahalagang seksyon, pero kanya-kanya po yung trabaho pagdating sa mga serbisyo at plataporma.

segments.text: Nagtanong din po tayo sa harap halimbawa ng DICT.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung ginagamit ba nila ng mga software, programs, online, learning platforms na binabayaran natin ng mga subscription,

segments.text: license renewal, yan ba ay gawa, na-develop ng mga Pilipino?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: na ngayon ay nagiging 19 pesos na,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, saan ba nanggaling yung hugot ng ating economic managers sa LIDAC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Bakit pinayaga nila at hindi sila nakapag-advise

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: na huwag nang isama yung mga asit na revenue generating

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: at mga mga businessbook na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Instead, mangutang tayo. Napakaliit, no? Mangutang tayo ng trilyon; ang kinakailangan sa Agus and Pulangi, bilyon lang na rehabilitation. After ma-rehabilitate, we solve the power [unclear], we reduce the cost of electricity, pati na yung Visayas kasi nag-i-import na si Mindanao ngayon ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: kuryente sa Visayas with the interconnection of Visayas and Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Tapos, nakinabang pa tayo sa employment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: isang asit lang ang tinutukoy ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: alam ko kung saan po punta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: wala na sa atin yung control.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi na nga natin masilip kung totoo

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: na gastusan yung planta na yan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Na mga planta na yan na hindi pa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: kasi may experience na tayo doon sa naunang

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: that you will look into that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and the membership of the ICC

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: is mostly po yung economic managers

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So I spoke to them po and they commit po that whichever projects po yung nabanggit na ating distinguished colleague po for evaluation, they will take a look at it po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So not just a value for money analysis on the part of the government, but also a bigger financial analysis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Medyo sa totoo po nakakabahala po yung binanggit na ating distinguished colleague na may mga pagkakataon po na pagkatapos i-privatize yung isang power plant, mas tumataas yung power rate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So ang naapektuhan po yung ating mga consumers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So if we may request po our distinguished colleague for a list of the particular projects that you would like for the ICC to look into for evaluation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: magiging masaya po yung ICC na test.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Tignan po yung mga proyekto na babanggitin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So we'll wait for the list po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Binanggit ko na po, ang natitira na lang natin ngayon ay Agus and Pulangi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang tinutukoy ko po, Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, na i-review yung na-privatize na magkano yung natanggap natin acquisition cost,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: magkano yung ginastos lang nila na na-rehabilitate din yung binta nila ngayon per kilowatt hour,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pakikita ninyo, napakabilis nilang mabawi yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: What if tayo na lang ang nangutang, tayo na lang ang nag-rehab,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: kontrolado pa natin yung presyo, hindi masasaktan yung ating mga taong bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yan yung punto na pinaparating ko dito, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi po yung ilang planta lang, kundi lahat po ng planta na ibinta natin, sure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: times to ang nagiging presyo na niya under the hands of the private sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: If we may, Mr. Speaker, our distinguished colleague, if we can also get the list of even those that have been privatized previously na po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: para po ma-evaluate din po ng ating economic managers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yung termal natin sa liti, yung latest, at saka yung kaliraya natin, yan yung mga latest.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Tingnan ko yung presyo, umiiyak yung mga taga-liti natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ayaw ko mangyari yung loha ng taga-liti na mangyari sa magiging loha ng Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Iba po ang kultura sa Mindanao, lalong-lalo na sa Agos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Iba po yung kultura ng liti.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Alam na siguro ng distinguished sponsor, yung punto na gusto kong iparating.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kung magkaroon ng privatization, kahit lang

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: kung sa rehabilitasyon at control ang operasyon ng Agos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: siguro, hindi matindi yung issue sa Pulangi, nasa bukid nun yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pero I don't know pagdating sa Agos, I don't know.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, ang susunod ko pong katanungan, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: ito po punta sa ating 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Tinalakay na natin yung 2027, pero kaya po ba nating punduhan yung 2026 natin na budget?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yung ga-an natin sa 2026, kaya po ba nating punduhan lahat yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, ang susunod ko pong katanungan, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: What I'm asking distinguished sponsor, Mr. Speaker, is that

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: before we discuss the current budget intended for 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: has the government the fiscal capacity to fully fund our 2026 general appropriations act?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: With us, our National Treasurer, sorry to quote our National Treasurer, but she gives the assurance that we will be able to fund our 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Okay, maganda naman pong ganoon pala, kaya naman pala natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, nakalimutan ko pa po yung isang nakapublish na yung Diliman property ng Napokor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang hindi ko rin maintindihan dyan, bakit ibinta natin, nandyan yung Napokor, nandyan nakaopisina yung Transco, ang ginawa, pinalipat si Napokor, nagririnta na lang ng 3.5 million a month.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: silang opisina. So siguro isama na rin pong tingnan yan ng mga economic

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: managers natin. Although hindi po siya ganun kabigat doon sa pag-privatize

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: ng isang planta. Kasi yung planta talaga nag-degenerate ka agad ng income

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: yun. Tapos nag-contribute pa na mapababa yung cost of electricity natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pero isama rin 'yan sa privatization kasi naalala ko kasama yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: diliman property ng napokor. So for my next point, Mr. Speaker, since you

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: categorically answer na kaya naman po nating punduhan yung 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: budget natin or yung ga-a, in 2027, ito po ay people-centered.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Sabi nga ni Secretary Kim ng DBM, ang meaning nito: Dapat ang Budget Makatao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So tama naman po yun. I agree with him. So may we ask the

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: good sponsor to explain what objective or criteria, no, such as the

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Philippine Development Plan for 2023 to 2028, sectoral plans, no, that needs

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: assessments, feasibility study, and measurable outcomes. We're used to

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: classify projects and programs as priorities across economic, social, defense,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: We also need to consider the debt-burdened sectors. Natanong na po ito kanina. Medyo pasensya na po, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, medyo nakulangan ako doon sa sagot kasi I agree with Congressman Tinio na medyo may mga nilagyan tayo ng budget na

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi naman totoong revenue generating yung contributor to economic growth na sana kung inuna natin yung ibang sektor na contributing to the economic growth, makikinabang din naman yung mga targeted subsidized sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, amid very limited fiscal space, increasing borrowing costs and growing debt levels, kinailangan pong mag-prioritize ng DBM sapagkat P[unclear] trillion po yung kabuuang budget proposals na dumating po sa kanila. So they had to prioritize P7.2 trillion out of that. The criteria that they used po, they employed five criteria:

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: First is alignment with the Philippine Development Plan. Second is shovel readiness. Third is absorptive capacity. Fourth is fiscal space. And fifth po, prioritization of government programs that deliver the highest value and impact. So yun po yung limang kriteriya na ginamit po ng DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Distinguished Sponsor. Pupunta po ako doon sa absorptive capacity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: I totally agree na tama po yung kriteriya na yun. But I have a reservation, no? In reality, for example, may I cite the sitio electrification program of NEA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Alam naman po natin yung economic contribution pag na-electrify natin yung isang lugar. Aside na nabigyan natin ng ginhawa yung mga tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Baka may mga negosyo. O hindi lang baka. In my experience, 43 years ako sa rural electrification, talagang umuunlad. Kaya nga yung mga barangay noon, nung nailawan na sa mga electric co-op yung area, nagiging munisipyo. Yung mga munisipyo nagiging city. Kaya malinaw po yung economic growth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pero pag-i-measure natin yung absorptive capacity ng NEA, dahil lang hindi nagastos yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mayroon po tayong hindi nakita na dahilan. Nire-release po yung pundo, third quarter. Pag-release mo ng third quarter, sa bidding process pa lang, kakainin na niya yung buong third quarter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pag-release ng DBM sa third quarter yan, mag-umpisa na yung project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Third quarter na, ay six months yung kailangan para ma-latag yung mga linya doon sa mga liblib na lugar. Ay talagang hindi niya ma-li-liquidate yun. Hindi ma-uubos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kaya kung titignan yan, ay hindi maganda yung absorptive capacity. Ang sinasabi ko po, ay tingnan yung mga gray area na yan. Kung i-release yan ng first quarter, I agree na kung 70 lang siya, 60 or less.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: May problema siya sa absorptive capacity. Kasi we are talking here, doon sa example ko, of extending the lines to par-plunk and unviable areas na hindi po basta-basta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May malaki po tayong inilagay dyan sa Barsi noong 2026 budget po kasi nag-release po tayo ng, if I'm not mistaken, 2 billion sa sityo electrification program po within NEA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, iti-check lang po ng pamilya natin sa DBM yung absorptive capacity utilization rate po ng NEA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang tinutukoy ko lang, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, Distinguished Sponsor, ang ginawa ko lang example yung NEA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: But I know, there are a lot of government agencies na hindi on time na-release yung kanilang budget appropriation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kaya, yung kriteriya natin na measurement na absorptive capacity, mayroon akong reservation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi kung sasabi ko, third quarter muna i-release yan, tapos yung project nila, DICT halimbawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: e, bibiding pa nila yung mga kawan, yung mga supplier, yung mga contractor, ay hindi talaga nila ma-liquidate yan at the end of the fiscal year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, magre-replic yan na mababa yung absorptive capacity nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, upon conferring with DBM, yes, they recognize that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Kasi po, halimbawa, second quarter na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Or, paminsan third quarter na po nare-release yung SARO, talaga po natatamaan po yung utilization rate ng ahensya sa buong taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, they will look into it po and make sure that instead of doing, siguro, a straight line assessment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: medyo baka pwedeng pro-rated yung approach para hindi naman po masaktan talaga yung utilization rate ng ahensya

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, DBM will look into it po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: I appreciate that. Sa lahat ng sekretary sa seven years ko dito, si Sekretary Kim lang ang umamin na titignan nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Lahat may mga ibang dahilan. So, thank you, Sekretary Kim, na titignan ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Lahat ng agency, ginawa ko lang example yung, ano, yung, actually, Mr. Speaker, may apat pa ako na issue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: favorite person ko. So, hindi ko na itatanong tong iba. Hindi ko na itatanong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, thank you, Mr. Speaker. Thank you sa mga sagot, Sekretary Kim, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much po to our distinguished colleague, Kong Sergio Dagooc. Thank you very much po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, the Honorable Dagooc. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Munir N. Arbison Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable...

segments.speaker: Rep. Crispin Diego D. Remulla
segments.text: Honorable Elijah San Fernando from Partylist Kamanggagawa to interplay it on the proposed budget on the debate on general principles and provisions.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The Honorable Elijah San Fernando of Partylist Kamanggagawa is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker, at sa ating kagalang-galang na sponsor, Chairperson Mika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Madam Sponsor, Mr. Speaker, kinikilala po ng Estado ang fundamental na karapatan ng mga Pilipino sa impormasyon po yung People's Right to Information,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And this simply means, Madam Sponsor, that transparency is paramount in all government proceedings, including the budget deliberations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: The general provisions contain six separate transparency sections.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Can the sponsor point to a single provision in the HGAB or the 2027 NEP that gives an ordinary citizen or a duly accredited organization the right to be heard on record before an appropriation is finalized?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, there are two stages where there is involvement, not in the GAAP, but the first stage would be during the budget call.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So during the budget preparation stage...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: yun noong budget calendar ng DBM na meron pong consultation sa atin pong mga civil society organizations

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: or kung sino po yung gusto mag-participate in the budget process.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: In the budget process, on that part po, there is section 54 which pertains to Philippine Open Government Partnership.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, departments, bureaus, offices, and instrumentalities of the national government, etc.,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: shall adopt the open government partnership values of transparency, accountability, and citizen participation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, doon po, nabanggit po yun, section 54.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We also have it not during the budget deliberations in Congress because that is a legislative function.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: But while that's not in the GA itself or in the special...

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: or general provisions, we've adopted that, we've institutionalized that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Within the House po, we've formed the task force for people's participation, we've done the people's budget review,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: we are refining the engagement models with civil society organizations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, meron din pong ganong engagement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: And then, when it comes to implementation, after the GA is passed, marami pong special provisions na nakakalat po sa iba't-ibang ahensya

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that allows people's audit for monitoring purposes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: I'm sure meron po under the special provision of the Department of Agriculture, for example,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: wherein a people's audit is allowed for infrastructure and for up-to-market road projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Sponsor, Mrs. Speaker, for pointing that out.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Na merong konsultasyon na nagaganap sa agency level bago po umakyat o pumasok dito sa Kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: the organizations would agree with me, and in fact, partner po natin, ang karamihan sa kanila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na kadalasan po, dito sa mga budget call ng mga ahensya ng gobyerno,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: hindi naman po talaga napaka-meaningful ng participation ng mga civil society organizations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: More often than not, nagiging stampad lang yung mga civil society organizations para lang masabi na merong participation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At maganda po na na-point out ng ating sponsor yung Section 54, which I will proceed to that later, Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Maganda po, Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, na binanggit ninyo na merong mga mekanismo tungkol sa transparency after the funds are already spent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: In fact, if we are going to read together all the sections pertaining to transparency, lahat ito ay pumapatungkol kapag na-spent na o na-gasos na yung pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So walang mga probisyon na pumapatungkol doon sa participation ng mga organizations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Inari yung Pilipino o na mga people's organizations, civil society organizations, doon sa proseso ng pagbalangkas pa lang ng budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Tama po ba ito, Madam Sponsor, Mr. Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, yes, we recognize that point.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: However, sa gaap po kasi, the special provisions there relate to budget implementation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: That's why there are no general or special provisions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: That pertain in the deliberation and the formulation of the budget itself.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So, yun po, kung titinan po natin, lahat po ng mga general provisions at special provisions na nakapaloob sa budget ay patungkol po sa budget implementation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Sponsor, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: so I've deferred to that on

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: still currently a bill under deliberation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: of the budget cycle is proactively

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and where citizen participation is integral

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: in all phases of the budget cycle

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: to promote informed, equitable, and responsive

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: and instrumentalities of the national government

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: are held responsible for the proper use,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: ensuring that all actions and expenditures

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: that we would have to do

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: doon po sa sektor na yun

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing

segments.text: But in the annex of the GAA,

segments.text: Uniform naman po kasi yung amount

segments.text: So it's lump sum in its presentation

segments.text: Meron pong nagsisinungaling at nanluloko sa mga manggagawa, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.
