segments.text: Adjacent, Madam Sponsor, adjacent o katabi nung the room, wala rin pong mga nag-me-meeting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: We know for a fact, because we were there, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Well, Madam Speaker, we understand the concern. Definitely, we share the same concern of the Honorable San Fernando. If it would be beneficial, I think the best course of action, at least at this point in time, there is a list of people who supposedly attended the meeting. We can just give you the list of people

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: and we can confirm if the meeting actually took place.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: I personally, this representation will help the Honorable San Fernando confirm this also.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mahalaga po na napag-uusapan natin ang bagay na ito, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Dahil meron pong hindi malinaw sa proseso ng pagtatakda ng meeting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Minimum wage at may kalituhang nangyayari na idinulot ng Wage Order 28 at ng Wage Order 27.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And it is surprising, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, na pati ang DepDev who sits as the ex-official vice chair of NWPC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pero kung binabanggit po ng butihing sponsor na magpoprovide ng mga dokumentasyon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na nagpapakita na merong naganap na pulong, gusto pong makita ng representasyong yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At maraming salamat po sa sponsor na tinitiyak na magkakaroon tayo ng kopya ng nasabing pulong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: But let it be put on record, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na kahit po ang DepDev ay lito at hindi alam ang mga espesipikong detalye

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na bahagi ng kanilang responsibilidad at ng kanilang mandato.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Proper time, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, kapag sumalang na po ang Department of Labor and Employment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: sisingilin po natin ang kagawaran na yun, batay sa record at sinasabi ng DepDev ngayon sa deliberasyong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Susunod po, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Sabi po ng Wage Order No. 28 kung saan pumirma ulit ang DepDev.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Sabi po, Wage Order No. 27 never took effect.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ano pong kalukuhan ito, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Is it the position of DepDev to say that Wage Order No. 27 never took effect?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kasi pumirma po sila, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, as for the DepDev, the reason for the non-implementation of Wage Order No. 27 is because

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: apparently there was a TRO that was issued the day before the meeting took place.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, non-implementation is different from the wording of Wage Order No. 28 which specifically say,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Wage Order No. 27 never took effect.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: What does that mean in popular parlance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang ibig sabihin po niyan, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, sinasabi ng Regional Wage Board

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na hindi naman nangyari yung dagdag sahod na P85.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: But it was the Secretary of the Department of Labor and Employment who announced it as historic wage increase.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: The question again is, is it the position of the DepDev to say that Wage Order No. 27 never took effect?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, on the part of DepDev, apparently this was a collegial decision.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: It was a collegial, but they signed. DepDev signed. So, it is the position.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: It's answerable by yes or no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Yun ang position ng DepDev, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: In the function of that, yes, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Yes. So, it is the position of DepDev to say that Wage Order No. 27 never took effect.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: 15 days upon the publication of any wage order, that wage order shall take effect.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Na-publish ba yung Wage Order No. 27?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thirdly, na-i-announce ba ng mismong kalihim ng DOLE?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Why is it the position of DepDev to say that Wage Order No. 27 never took effect?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, on the part of DepDev, it's really the TRO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Apparently, there was a declaration also of the status quo ante.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, it's because of the TRO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: there was an order coming from Pasig RTC Branch 152.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: let a preliminary injunction be issued upon putting up a bond of 10 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: In the previous DOLE budget consideration in the committee,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: it was the Department of Labor and Employment Secretary himself who said,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, if there is no bond, then there is no injunction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: The rules of court is very specific about this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Now, without a bond, walang preliminary injunction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Indispensable requirement ng preliminary injunction ang bond.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ngayon, wala pong nailagak na bond.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: it is the position of the office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: the office of the Solicitor General,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: there is no legal impediment in enforcing Wage Order No. 27.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: even if that is very clear sa ating mga batas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: why is it the position of DepDev to say that Wage Order No. 27 never took effect?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, again, just on the part of DepDev,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang punto ko po, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: sa dinami-rami ko pong binanggit ng mga puntos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: mismong DepDev na bahagi ng NWPC

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ay lito, una, sa mga tunay na nangyari at naganap

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: leading to the issuance of Wage Order No. 27.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mas nalito pa tayo lahat dahil may existing Wage Order No. 27

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: at naglabas ng panibagong Wage Order No. 28

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: kahit labag ito sa rules mismo ng NWPC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Second point, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Third point, hindi rin nagkaroon ng meeting ang NWPC

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: para pagtibayin yung Wage Order No. 28.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pero binabanggit kanina, nagkaroon daw ng pulong,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Malaman o matandaan saan sila nagpulong,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: anong oras sila nagpulong, at merong kalituhan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: mas nagbibigay ito ng maraming tanong kaysa kalinawan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kaya ako po binibigyang din ito, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: malinaw po kasi na merong wage rollback na nangyari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Wage Order No. 27, total wage increase amounts to P85.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: P60 of which, the first tranche,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: That means, kapag in-implement yung Wage Order No. 27,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: may retroactive pay ang mga manggagawang minimum wage earner

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, pumapatak ang metro, mahigit P3,000 na ang naaagaw mula sa mga manggagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Malaking tulong yan para sa mga manggagawa, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ng NWPC, ng DOLE, kung ano yung kanyang mandato,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dahil iginawad yan ng Kongreso sa visa ng RA 6727,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: nakikita po natin na parang isinasantabi o isinusuko

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ng NWPC mismo kung saan pahagi ang DepDev,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: bilang merong exclusive jurisdiction on wage determination.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Yun po ang punto dito, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mas malaking problema, because of Wage Order No. 28,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: wala nang aasahan na retroactive pay yung mga manggagawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: unless otherwise clarified and cleared by the court.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang problema pa dito, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na wala na yung dagdag na P25 sa mga minimum wage earners

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And it will produce another question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kung ang posisyon ng NWPC ay para magkaroon ng inovasyon

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: maibigay na sa mga manggagawa, yung P60,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ibig sabihin ba magkakaroon ng Wage Order No. 29?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Na magsasabi, magdagdag tayo ng panibagong P25

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: para sa mga minimum wage earners.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: E di-veniolate na, nilabag na ng NWPC

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Naglabas ng dalawang wage order sa isang taon

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: at ngayon may question kung maglalabas ulit ng panibagong wage order.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Yun po ang punto dito, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mismong mga regional wage boards, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ay hindi sumusunod sa mga proseso ng batas

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na ginawa para itakda yung minimum wage natatanggap ng mga manggagawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ikalawa, nilalabag pa mismo ng mga ahensa ng gobyerno

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: logical lang na dapat reviewhin o repasuhin ang batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ngayon po, kung nakikita natin na may kaguluhan na nagaganap

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dito sa wage setting determination natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: nakakapagtaka po, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: is not the right thing to do.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Papaano pong bibigyang matwid ng Dep-Def

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na malaki ang problema sa mga regional wage boards?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: If we're going back to our history,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: pinoproteksyonan niya yung wage setting mechanism?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: mailayo natin mula sa awayan sa politika

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: nakikita na natin lahat ng kinatatakutan

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ng mga gumawa ng batas noong 1989.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: at ikalawa, nilalabag na mismo ng gobyerno

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: kung ano ang nakasulat sa batas

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: papunta doon sa National Wages and Productivity Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And what we're going to hear

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: is that legislating a minimum wage

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: is not the right thing to do.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Is it still the position of the government?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Is it still the position of Dep-Dev

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na hindi po magkaroon ng legislated wage increase

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: which determines and defines wage-setting mechanism?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: The Chair would like to remind Representative San Fernando

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: At least on the part of Dep-Dev,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: the Dep-Dev will just adhere to what the law says

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Can you repeat that, Madam Sponsor, Madam Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: It would adhere to what the law prescribed

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: with regards to determination of wages.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: as much as I would like to believe that,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: alam niyo po, kanina ko pa po pinaulit-ulit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: mga batas na po mismo na dapat nilang sundin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mga batas na nakasulat sa ating...

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na iginawad sa kanila ng kongresyong ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Tapos sasabihin nila sa atin ngayon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: gagalangin nila kung ano nakasulat sa batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ano ba namang clashing Dep-Dev yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So alam ko po, time's up na po ako, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At least nabigyan po ng kalinawan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: at sa lahat po ng mga manggagawang minimum wage earner

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: sa NCR at sa buong Pilipinas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ito po ang mga economic managers natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Puro kalituhan ang ginagawa sa mga manggagawang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: of the Gabriela Women's Party List

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: is now recognized for her interpellation.
